fluoxetine (Rx)
Brand and Other Names: Prozac
Dosage Forms & Strengths
capsule
10mg
Interactions
Contraindicated (1)

pimozide
fluoxetine and pimozide both increase QTc interval. Contraindicated.

Serious (1)

amitriptyline
fluoxetine increases amitriptyline levels through CYP2C19. Avoid or Use Alternate Drug.
Adverse Effects
